items.title: Credibility and strength of evidence for exercise, nutritional, and combined interventions on muscle function and physical performance in older adults: an umbrella review of meta-analyses of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: An umbrella review of meta-analyses found the strongest evidence for exercise interventions in older adults, especially for fall prevention. Nutrition-only interventions may modestly benefit muscle mass in specific populations, and combined interventions show some promise for strength and function.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述建议，在老年人干预中，以预防跌倒为目标的运动疗法证据最为充分。营养干预可能仅在特定人群中对肌肉量有适度益处，联合干预在力量和功能方面显示出一定潜力，但运动仍是核心。
items.titleZh: 运动、营养和联合干预对老年人肌肉功能和身体机能的证据可信度和强度：一项随机对照试验荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃分析的伞形综述发现，老年人中最有力的证据支持运动干预，特别是用于跌倒预防。单独的营养干预可能对特定人群的肌肉质量有适度益处，联合干预在改善力量和功能方面显示出一些前景。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review of meta-analyses suggests that exercise-based interventions, particularly for fall prevention, have the most consistently supported evidence in older adults. While nutrition may benefit muscle mass in specific groups, and combined interventions show some promise, exercise remains a cornerstone.
items.limitation: 大量综述重叠、临床异质性以及原始综述质量参差不齐，限制了结论的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Significant review overlap, clinical heterogeneity, and variable quality of source reviews limit the certainty of conclusions.

items.title:
Clinical and functional outcomes of aquatic plyometrics in adolescent patellofemoral pain syndrome: a dual-arm randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A dual-arm RCT found aquatic plyometric exercises significantly improved pain, quadriceps and hamstring torque, functional disability, and quality of life in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome compared to conventional exercises.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT证实，与传统锻炼相比，水中增强式训练能显著改善青少年髌骨股骨疼痛综合征患者的疼痛、股四头肌和腘绳肌力量、功能障碍及生活质量。应考虑将其纳入临床实践。
items.titleZh: 青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者水生增强式训练的临床和功能结局：一项双臂随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双臂随机对照试验显示，与常规练习相比，水生增强式练习能显著改善青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者的疼痛、股四头肌和腘绳肌扭矩、功能障碍和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides strong evidence that aquatic plyometrics are superior to conventional exercises for improving pain, strength, function, and quality of life in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome. Clinicians should consider incorporating this intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究在沙特阿拉伯进行；其结果推广至其他人群需谨慎考虑。
items.limitationEn: Study conducted in Saudi Arabia; generalizability to other populations needs consideration.

items.title:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates-based exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, depressive symptoms, and perceived stress compared to usual care in adults with fibromyalgia.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量RCT表明，为期6个月的结合了普拉提和自我筋膜松解的监督式远程康复计划，在改善纤维肌痛患者的疾病影响、睡眠质量和心理健康方面，显著优于常规护理。这是远程医疗干预的有力循证选择。
items.titleZh: 结合了普拉提式治疗性运动和自我筋膜松解的为期六个月的监督远程康复对成人纤维肌痛症的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期六个月的监督式多组分远程康复计划，结合了普拉提式练习和自我筋膜松解，与常规护理相比，显著改善了纤维肌痛症患者的纤维肌痛症影响、睡眠质量、抑郁症状和感知压力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT demonstrates that a 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates and self-myofascial release significantly improves fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and psychological outcomes compared to usual care. This offers a strong evidence-based option for telehealth delivery.
items.limitation: 本研究在希腊进行；未评估超出6个月的长期效果。
items.limitationEn: Study conducted in Greece; long-term effects beyond 6 months were not assessed.

items.title: The role of core stability training in improving balance and poomsae technique quality in taekwondo poomsae athletes with neuromuscular control deficits with trunk involvement: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: Core stability training significantly improved static and dynamic balance, trunk muscle endurance, and selected poomsae performance measures in taekwondo athletes, though only specific trunk endurance and balance measures showed significant between-group differences post-correction.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT提示，核心稳定性训练可提升跆拳道品势运动员的平衡能力和躯干肌肉耐力，部分表现指标也有改善。然而，其对竞技优势和伤病预防的直接转化价值仍需进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 核心稳定性训练在改善患有躯干参与的神经肌肉控制缺陷的跆拳道品势运动员的平衡和品势技术质量中的作用：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 核心稳定性训练显著改善了跆拳道运动员的静态和动态平衡、躯干肌肉耐力以及选定的品势表现指标，但仅在校正后特定躯干耐力和平衡指标显示出显著的组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that core stability training can improve balance and trunk muscle endurance in taekwondo poomsae athletes, with some improvements in selected sport-specific performance. While promising, the direct translation to competitive advantage and injury reduction requires further investigation.
items.limitation: 本研究在伊朗进行；部分运动表现指标和受伤风险的改善不显著。
items.limitationEn: Study conducted in Iran; improvements in some performance measures and injury risk were not significant.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Low balance confidence in relation to strength training, walking, sitting, and physical function among women aged 75–105 years: a cross-sectional study within the Women’s Health Initiative Strong and Healthy (WHISH) Intervention Cohort
items.summary: In women aged 75-105, low balance confidence was associated with increased sitting time and lower physical function, while higher balance confidence was linked to more strength training and walking. The prevalence of low balance confidence was higher in those aged 85+.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对75-105岁老年女性的横断面研究发现，平衡信心不足与久坐时间增加、身体功能下降相关，而平衡信心高则与力量训练、步行活动及更好的身体功能相关。这强化了在老年人群中推广这些活动的重要性。
items.titleZh: 75-105岁女性的平衡信心低与力量训练、行走、久坐和身体功能的关系：一项女性健康倡议强健与健康（WHISH）干预队列的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 在75-105岁的女性中，平衡信心低与久坐时间增加和身体功能下降有关，而平衡信心高则与更多的力量训练和行走有关。85岁以上女性的低平衡信心患病率更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study in older women (75-105 years) identifies strong associations between lower balance confidence and factors like sitting time, while higher confidence is linked to strength training, walking, and better physical function. This reinforces the importance of promoting these activities in geriatric populations.
items.limitation: 横断面设计限制了时间顺序的确定；研究结果需在纵向研究中得到证实。
items.limitationEn: Cross-sectional design limits the establishment of temporality; findings need confirmation in longitudinal studies.

items.title: The experiences of physiotherapists regarding self-management practices for patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, South Africa: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in South Africa explored physiotherapists' experiences with self-management for chronic low back pain, identifying themes related to patient beliefs, treatment elements, social factors, and interprofessional teamwork, emphasizing a biopsychosocial approach.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了南非物理治疗师在慢性腰痛自我管理方面的挑战。由于缺乏定量证据，其临床实践的直接指导意义有限，仅供了解区域性问题背景。
items.titleZh: 南非物理治疗师对非特异性慢性腰痛患者自我管理实践的经验：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项在南非进行的定性研究，探讨了物理治疗师在慢性腰痛患者自我管理方面的经验，确定了与患者信念、治疗要素、社会因素和跨专业团队合作相关的几个主题，并强调了生物心理社会模型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study explores physiotherapists' perspectives on self-management for chronic low back pain in South Africa. While the findings highlight the importance of a biopsychosocial approach, the study design limits its direct impact on clinical practice without further quantitative evidence. Consider this for background understanding of regional challenges.
items.limitation: 定性研究设计限制了其普遍性和对临床方案的直接影响。
items.limitationEn: Qualitative design limits generalizability and direct impact on clinical protocols.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Effects of extracorporeal shockwave therapy on pain intensity and functional disability in chronic low back pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs (N=430) found that radial extracorporeal shockwave therapy (rESWT) significantly reduced pain in chronic low back pain (SMD = -0.72; 95% CI -1.30 to -0.14), but functional improvements (MD = -6.12) did not meet the minimal clinically important difference.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性腰痛，体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）特别是径向冲击波（rESWT）在短期疼痛管理上显示出中等效应量（SMD = -0.72），但功能改善的临床意义不明显。别将其作为独立疗法，而应作为运动疗法的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 体外冲击波疗法对慢性腰痛疼痛强度和功能障碍的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含9项RCT（N=430）的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，径向体外冲击波疗法（rESWT）可显著减轻慢性腰痛患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.72），但功能改善（MD = -6.12）未达到临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT), especially radial ESWT (rESWT), shows a moderate effect size (SMD = -0.72) for short-term pain reduction, but functional improvements are not clinically meaningful. Do not consider it a standalone treatment; use it as an adjunct to exercise therapy.
items.limitation: 本系统综述的证据多为干预后即时评估，随访期短，且各研究间存在显著异质性。
items.limitationEn: Evidence in this systematic review is largely based on immediate post-intervention assessments with short follow-up, and there is significant heterogeneity among studies.

items.title: Physical activity guidelines' impact on cognition in multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 RCTs (N=462) found that meeting physical activity guidelines for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) significantly improved processing speed (SMD = 0.29), visuospatial memory (SMD = 0.47), and verbal memory (SMD = 0.75).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，达到多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动指南要求，可以显著改善处理速度和记忆力。在管理MS患者时，将达标的运动处方纳入认知康复计划，这应成为你的首选干预方案。
items.titleZh: 身体活动指南对多发性硬化症患者认知功能的影响：随机临床试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含12项RCT（N=462）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，达到多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动指南要求，可显著改善处理速度（SMD = 0.29）、视觉空间记忆（SMD = 0.47）和言语记忆（SMD = 0.75）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clearly indicates that meeting physical activity guidelines for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) can significantly improve processing speed and memory. When managing MS patients, incorporating guideline-compliant exercise prescriptions into cognitive rehabilitation programs should be your preferred intervention.
items.limitation: 本系统综述纳入的随机对照试验数量有限，且存在较高偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included a limited number of randomized controlled trials with a high risk of bias.

items.title: Feasibility of Distributed Wearable Ultrasound for Detecting Neuromuscular Coordination Differences After Knee Injury
items.summary: A feasibility study with 20 NCAA Division I women athletes (8 with prior knee injury) using a four-channel distributed wearable ultrasound (D-WUS) system found that D-WUS detected significant differences in right-limb neuromuscular coordination (VL-VMO correlation p=0.029; timing symmetry p=0.019) in those with previous knee injuries, differences not reflected in force-plate biomechanics.
items.curatedReason: 可穿戴超声系统在检测膝关节损伤后神经肌肉协调性差异方面表现出可行性，且能发现传统力板生物力学未反映出的问题。在评估和监测膝关节康复进展时，未来可以考虑将其作为客观量化肌肉收缩模式的补充工具，但目前尚需大规模研究验证其临床实用性。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴分布式超声检测膝关节损伤后神经肌肉协调差异的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对20名NCAA一级大学女子运动员（8名有既往膝关节损伤）的可行性研究，使用四通道分布式可穿戴超声（D-WUS）系统，发现在有既往膝关节损伤的运动员中，D-WUS能检测到右肢神经肌肉协调性的显著差异（VL-VMO相关性 p=0.029；时间对称性 p=0.019），这些差异未在力板生物力学中体现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Wearable ultrasound systems show feasibility in detecting neuromuscular coordination differences after knee injury, revealing issues not reflected by traditional force plate biomechanics. In assessing and monitoring knee rehabilitation progress, consider it a supplementary tool for objective quantification of muscle contraction patterns, though large-scale studies are needed to validate its clinical utility.
items.limitation: 本研究是初步的可行性研究，样本量小（N=20），且仅限于大学女子运动员这一特定人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary feasibility study with a small sample size (N=20) and is limited to a specific population of NCAA Division I women athletes.

items.title: Significant others' perspectives on formal supports at 3- and 12-months post-discharge from specialist rehabilitation units following acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring perspectives of 24 significant others at 3 months and 19 at 12 months post-discharge from inpatient rehabilitation found that family members play a central role in filling gaps in formal support systems for individuals with acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury, highlighting communication and support understanding as key barriers.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后，家庭成员在正式支持服务中面临的挑战。作为临床医生，你必须主动且清晰地向家属提供支持资源信息，并更早地将他们纳入康复决策过程，以减轻家属的负担并提高患者依从性。
items.titleZh: 脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 个月和 12 个月主要照护者对正式支持的看法
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究调查了24名和19名主要照护者在脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后3个月和12个月的看法，发现家庭成员在弥补正式支持系统不足方面发挥核心作用，并强调沟通和对支持的理解是主要障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the challenges faced by family members in accessing formal support services after discharge for patients with acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury. As a clinician, you must proactively and clearly provide families with information about support resources and involve them earlier in the rehabilitation decision-making process to alleviate caregiver burden and improve patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性方法，样本量相对较小，结果主要反映了特定地区（澳大利亚昆士兰州）家属的视角。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a relatively small sample size, and its findings primarily reflect the perspectives of family members in a specific region (Queensland, Australia).

items.title: Process evaluation of daily electrical stimulation to prevent recurring pressure ulcers in individuals with spinal cord injury: the SCI PREVOLT trial.
items.summary: A mixed-methods process evaluation with 70 participants and 13 healthcare professionals assessed the implementation of electrical stimulation (ES) for pressure ulcer prevention in individuals with spinal cord injury, identifying limited evidence, usability issues, and organizational barriers (e.g., lack of reimbursement) that hinder adoption and adherence in home and rehabilitation settings.
items.curatedReason: 这项过程评估揭示了在家用和康复环境中实施电刺激预防脊髓损伤压疮的障碍，包括证据有限、可用性差和组织问题。在你考虑推广或应用类似技术时，务必关注这些实际障碍，确保有明确的指导和支持。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者日常电刺激预防压疮复发的过程评估：SCI PREVOLT 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项包含70名参与者和13名医疗专业人员的混合方法过程评估，旨在评估电刺激（ES）预防脊髓损伤压疮的实施情况，发现证据有限、可用性问题和组织障碍（如缺乏报销）是阻碍在家用和康复环境中采用和依从性的主要因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This process evaluation reveals barriers to implementing electrical stimulation for pressure ulcer prevention in spinal cord injury patients at home and in rehabilitation settings, including limited evidence, poor usability, and organizational issues. When considering the adoption or promotion of similar technologies, you must address these practical barriers by ensuring clear guidance and support.
items.limitation: 本研究是一项过程评估，主要关注实施障碍，而非干预措施本身的疗效。研究结果基于混合方法，可能存在定性数据的主观性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a process evaluation focusing on implementation barriers rather than the efficacy of the intervention itself. The findings are based on mixed methods, which may involve subjectivity in qualitative data.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that thoracic kinesiological taping combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF) and inspiratory muscle strength (MIP) in chronic post-stroke hemiplegia patients, with greater changes in the KT group compared to sham taping.
items.curatedReason: 胸部肌内效贴可以作为卒中后偏瘫患者呼吸功能康复的辅助疗法，尤其在改善肺功能和吸气肌力量方面有显著优势，但它主要优化通气力学，而非直接增强肌肉力量。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力量和功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，胸部肌内效贴结合常规康复治疗显著改善了慢性卒中后偏瘫患者的肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF）和吸气肌力量（MIP），肌内效贴组的变化大于假贴组。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracic kinesiology taping can serve as an adjunctive therapy for respiratory function rehabilitation in post-stroke hemiplegia patients, showing significant advantages in improving pulmonary function and inspiratory muscle strength. However, it primarily optimizes ventilatory mechanics rather than directly enhancing muscle strength.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，随访期仅为4周，且未探讨长期效果和机制。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, a follow-up period of only 4 weeks, and did not explore long-term effects or mechanisms.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=81) found that kinesio taping and myofascial release, both combined with home exercises, were effective short-term treatments for cervicogenic headache, significantly reducing pain, disability, and headache frequency, with MFR potentially offering more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 对于颈源性头痛患者，肌内效贴和筋膜松弛术联合居家锻炼都能有效缓解短期疼痛和头痛频率，筋膜松弛术在残疾和生活质量方面可能提供更持久的改善，支持将其整合到多模式康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴与筋膜松弛术治疗颈源性头痛的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=81）发现，肌内效贴和筋膜松弛术联合居家锻炼是治疗颈源性头痛的有效短期方案，能显著减轻疼痛、残疾和头痛频率；筋膜松弛术在残疾和身体生活质量方面可能提供更持久的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with cervicogenic headache, both kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy combined with home exercises effectively reduce short-term pain and headache frequency. Myofascial release may offer more sustained improvements in disability and quality of life, supporting their integration into multimodal rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究的随访期较短，仅评估了短期效果和1个月随访，无法确证长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: The study has a short follow-up period, only assessing short-term effects and 1-month follow-up, which prevents confirmation of long-term efficacy.

items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises significantly improved upper extremity motor function (FMA-UE MD = 3.95) and shoulder/elbow muscle strength in chronic ischemic stroke patients compared to sham, though FMA-UE clinical relevance needs cautious interpretation.
items.curatedReason: 经皮耳迷走神经刺激 (taVNS) 有望成为慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢功能康复的辅助手段。但请注意，FMA-UE 临床相关性需谨慎解读。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，与假治疗相比，经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）联合上肢锻炼显著改善了慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢运动功能（FMA-UE MD = 3.95）及肩肘肌肉力量，但 FMA-UE 的临床相关性需谨慎解读。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) shows promise as an adjunct for upper extremity motor function recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. However, be cautious as the FMA-UE clinical relevance needs cautious interpretation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，仅限于慢性缺血性卒中，且未达到关键结局指标FMA-UE的临床最小重要差异。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, is limited to chronic ischemic stroke, and the key outcome FMA-UE did not reach the minimal clinically important difference.

items.title: Development and validation of a prediction model for subsequent fractures after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study developed and validated a nomogram to predict subsequent fractures within 2 years after hip fracture surgery in older adults, showing good discriminative performance (C-index 0.891 in development cohort) with age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, and living alone as predictors, and exercise as a protective factor.
items.curatedReason: 对于髋部骨折术后的老年患者，这个回顾性队列研究提示我们可以通过年龄、髋关节功能、神经退行性疾病、眼疾和独居等因素，加上运动史，初步判断两年内再骨折的风险。不过，这只是个回顾性观察研究，在临床上真正使用这个列线图前，需要更强的RCT证据验证其前瞻性预测效力。
items.titleZh: 老年髋部骨折术后再次骨折预测模型的开发与验证：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究开发并验证了一个用于预测老年髋部骨折术后两年内再次骨折的列线图。该模型表现出良好的区分度（开发队列 C-index 0.891），识别出年龄、髋关节功能、神经退行性疾病、眼疾、独居为预测因素，运动为保护因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults post-hip fracture surgery, this retrospective cohort study suggests we can use factors like age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, and living alone, alongside exercise history, to estimate the risk of re-fracture within two years. However, this is a retrospective observational study; stronger RCT evidence is needed to prospectively validate its predictive power before clinical implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，尽管进行了时间验证，但仍需要前瞻性研究来进一步确认模型的预测性能和临床实用性。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study; despite temporal validation, prospective studies are needed to further confirm the model's predictive performance and clinical utility.

items.title: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored barriers and facilitators influencing Austrian physiotherapists' adherence to CPGs and return to sport criteria after ACL reconstruction. Key barriers included limited guideline usability, patient expectations, resource limitations, and interprofessional misalignment, while facilitators included structured guidelines and professional development.
items.curatedReason: 你在 ACL 重建康复中推动 CPGs 依从性时，需要注意患者的期望和跨专业沟通问题，这两点可能比指南本身的设计更影响治疗师的执行。本研究提示，提升指南可用性和专业发展仍是关键。
items.titleZh: 影响物理治疗师依从 ACLR 康复临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素：一项澳大利亚定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响澳大利亚物理治疗师在 ACL 重建术后康复中依从临床实践指南 (CPGs) 和重返运动 (RTS) 标准的障碍和促进因素。主要障碍包括指南可用性有限、患者期望、资源限制和跨专业失调，而促进因素则包括结构化指南和专业发展。
items.curatedReasonEn: When promoting CPG adherence in ACL reconstruction rehab, patient expectations and interprofessional communication are likely more influential than guideline design itself. This study suggests that improving guideline usability and professional development remain crucial facilitators.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（9 名物理治疗师），结果主要反映受访者主观感知。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (9 physiotherapists), and its findings primarily reflect subjective perceptions.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study established sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in 216 elite junior and senior TeamGym gymnasts, finding significant sex × age-group interactions for hop for distance and side-hop performance, with senior males outperforming junior males across all hop outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本研究首次提供了精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模，揭示了不同性别和年龄组间表现差异。这些常模是你在康复和重返运动评估中可用的重要参考基准。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究确立了 216 名精英少年和成年 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢功能表现的性别和年龄特异性常模，发现跳远和侧跳表现存在显著的性别 × 年龄组交互作用，其中成年男性在所有跳跃结果上均优于少年男性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study is the first to provide sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts, revealing performance differences between groups. These norms are valuable reference benchmarks for your rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法追踪运动员长期表现变化或预测损伤风险。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design, which cannot track long-term changes in athlete performance or predict injury risk.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary randomized crossover study found that a single session of high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises increased corticospinal excitability by 22.3% in chronic stroke patients, though this was not statistically significant.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，HD-tACS 结合机器人辅助手部训练可能短期提升卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性。但仍需更大样本研究验证其临床意义。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激 (HD-tACS) 结合机器人辅助手部训练对慢性卒中皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机交叉研究发现，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激 (HD-tACS) 结合机器人辅助手部训练，使慢性卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性增加了约 22.3%，但该变化未达到统计学显著性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that HD-tACS combined with robot-assisted hand exercises may acutely enhance corticospinal excitability in stroke patients. However, larger studies are needed to confirm its clinical significance.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步小样本（7 名卒中患者）研究，缺乏长期随访数据，无法确定干预的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary small-sample study (7 stroke patients) lacking long-term follow-up data, thus unable to determine the clinical efficacy of the intervention.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: How do neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs? Findings from a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Italy explored how neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs, finding that care encompasses physical, psychosocial, and relational dimensions, emphasizing dignity, respectful communication, emotional support, and empathy beyond technical tasks.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了神经康复患者对“基本照护”的需求不仅限于身体任务，更包含社会心理和关系维度。将其纳入你的康复评估和护理计划，有助于提供更全面和以患者为中心的照护。
items.titleZh: 神经康复患者如何看待其基本照护需求？一项定性研究的发现
items.summaryZh: 一项在意大利进行的定性研究探讨了神经康复患者如何看待其基本照护需求，发现照护涵盖身体、社会心理和关系维度，强调尊严、尊重沟通、情感支持和同理心，而非仅仅技术任务。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study emphasizes that neurorehabilitation patients' 'fundamental care' needs extend beyond physical tasks to include psychosocial and relational dimensions. Incorporating these into your rehabilitation assessment and care planning can help you provide more comprehensive, person-centered care.
items.limitation: 本研究为意大利一家康复医院的定性分析，结果可能受文化背景和特定医疗环境影响。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative analysis was conducted at a rehabilitation hospital in Italy, and its findings may be influenced by cultural background and specific healthcare settings.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends Study (2011-2024) found that community-dwelling older adults with a history of stroke had a significantly higher prevalence of bothersome pain (60.77% vs 54.66%) and activity-limiting pain (62.83% vs 52.00%) compared to those without stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项对 NHATS 数据的分析证实，社区居住的卒中老年人报告的恼人疼痛和活动受限性疼痛发生率显著更高（OR 1.30 和 1.20）。在老年卒中康复中，你应高度重视疼痛评估和管理。
items.titleZh: 社区居住老年卒中患者与非卒中老年人恼人疼痛和活动受限性疼痛的比较：一项全国健康老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对全国健康老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析发现，社区居住的卒中史老年人比无卒中史老年人，恼人疼痛（60.77% vs 54.66%）和活动受限性疼痛（62.83% vs 52.00%）的患病率显著更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis of NHATS data confirms that community-dwelling older adults with stroke report a significantly higher prevalence of bothersome (OR 1.30) and activity-limiting pain (OR 1.20). You should prioritize pain assessment and management in geriatric stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面分析，无法建立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional analysis, which cannot establish a causal relationship between stroke and pain.

items.title: Quality of Movement Assessment after ACL Reconstruction in Youth: A Clinical Framework to Guide Rehabilitation and Return-to-Sport Decision-Making.
items.summary: This commentary describes a clinical framework for implementing and interpreting quality of movement assessment tools for single-leg, double-leg, and change of direction tasks in pediatric and adolescent patients following ACL reconstruction to guide rehabilitation and return-to-sport decision-making.
items.curatedReason: 本述评为青年运动员 ACLR 术后康复和重返运动决策提供了运动质量评估工具的临床框架。将其作为辅助，丰富你的 RTS 评估方案，以降低再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 青年 ACL 重建术后运动质量评估：指导康复与重返运动决策的临床框架
items.summaryZh: 本述评描述了一个临床框架，用于在青少年 ACL 重建术后，实施和解释单腿、双腿和变向任务的运动质量评估工具，以指导康复和重返运动决策。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary provides a clinical framework for assessing movement quality in youth athletes after ACLR to guide rehabilitation and return-to-sport decisions. Use it to enrich your RTS assessment protocol and reduce re-injury risk.
items.limitation: 本评论是专家意见，未提供原创研究数据支持其推荐的框架。
items.limitationEn: This commentary represents expert opinion and does not provide original research data to support its proposed framework.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Force Plate Based Assessment of Maximal and Rapid Isometric Shoulder Strength During the Return-to-Sport Process After Pectoralis Major Repair in a World-Class Female Wrestler: A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report of a world-class female wrestler after pectoralis major repair found that rapid force production (NF200) recovery lagged behind maximal peak force (NPF) recovery, especially in the Y-position, during weekly force plate-based shoulder strength assessments.
items.curatedReason: 本病例报告展示了在世界级女摔跤手胸大肌修复后，使用测力台评估肩部最大和快速等长力量以指导重返运动的过程。它提示快速力量恢复可能滞后于最大力量，在评估运动员时应多加关注。
items.titleZh: 世界级女摔跤手胸大肌修复后重返运动过程中基于测力台的最大和快速等长肩部力量评估：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名世界级女摔跤手胸大肌修复后的病例报告显示，在每周基于测力台的肩部力量评估中，快速力量产生 (NF200) 的恢复滞后于最大峰值力量 (NPF) 的恢复，尤其在 Y 位。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report details the use of force plate-based assessment of maximal and rapid isometric shoulder strength to guide return-to-sport after pectoralis major repair in a world-class female wrestler. It suggests that rapid force production recovery may lag behind maximal strength, which you should consider when assessing athletes.
items.limitation: 本研究为单例病例报告，结果不具有普遍性，不能推广到其他人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and its findings are not generalizable to other populations.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sensorimotor and Molecular Mechanisms of Non-Contact ACL Injury: An Integrative Hypothesis.
items.summary: This clinical commentary proposes an integrative theoretical model for non-contact ACL injury, emphasizing the decisive protective role of pre-established feed-forward hamstring tension and calcium-dependent stiffening of titin, and identifying pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric-strength training as cornerstones of prevention.
items.curatedReason: 本述评提出了非接触性 ACL 损伤的集成性假说，强调了前馈蕀绳肌张力、肌联蛋白的钙依赖性僵硬及离心训练在损伤预防中的关键作用。这为你理解和设计预防策略提供了新的理论视角。
items.titleZh: 非接触性 ACL 损伤的传感器运动和分子机制：一个整合性假说
items.summaryZh: 本临床述评提出了非接触性 ACL 损伤的整合理论模型，强调预先建立的前馈腘绳肌张力和肌联蛋白的钙依赖性僵硬的决定性保护作用，并将触地前着陆策略和离心力量训练确定为预防基石。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary proposes an integrative hypothesis for non-contact ACL injuries, emphasizing the critical role of feed-forward hamstring tension, titin's calcium-dependent stiffening, and eccentric training in injury prevention. This offers you a new theoretical perspective for understanding and designing prevention strategies.
items.limitation: 本评论是基于现有研究的理论模型，需进一步实证研究验证其假说。
items.limitationEn: This commentary is a theoretical model based on existing research, and its hypotheses require further empirical validation.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of treadmill exercise with and without vertical traction on gait, pain, disability, trunk proprioception, and depression in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: Adding vertical traction and partial body weight support to treadmill exercise improved gait, disability, and trunk repositioning more than treadmill exercise alone in chronic low back pain patients (n=45).
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性腰痛患者，在跑步机训练基础上联合垂直牵引和减重支持，能进一步改善步态、残疾程度和躯干重定位，效果优于单独跑步机训练。但该研究样本量（n=45）有限，结论尚需更多证据。
items.titleZh: 跑步机结合垂直牵引和部分体重支持对慢性机械性腰痛患者步态、疼痛、残疾、躯干本体感觉及抑郁症状的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Effects of treadmill exercise with and without vertical traction on gait, pain, disability, trunk proprioception, and depression in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summaryZh: 在一项针对 45 名慢性机械性腰痛患者的随机对照试验中，跑步机结合垂直牵引和部分体重支持在改善步态、残疾和躯干重新定位方面，优于单独的跑步机运动或核心稳定性训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests adding vertical traction and partial body weight support to treadmill exercise may offer additional benefits for gait, disability, and trunk repositioning in chronic low back pain patients, beyond treadmill exercise alone or core stabilization. While promising, the small sample size limits definitive conclusions.
items.limitation: 样本量小，且无法区分垂直卸载与支架支撑的效果。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size and inability to distinguish effects of vertical unloading from harness support.

items.title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: In older adults (≥60 yrs) with atraumatic massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs), 95-97% achieved minimal clinically important difference after 12 weeks of nonoperative treatment, sustained to 4 years; longer symptom duration and smoking were associated with worse function.
items.curatedReason: 对于≥60岁、非创伤性巨大不可修复性肩袖撕裂（MIRCTs）的老年患者，12周非手术治疗可带来大部分患者都达到的、并能维持4年的临床获益。病程越长、吸烟者的功能预后越差。
items.titleZh: 巨大不可修复性肩袖撕裂老年患者的长期临床结局及反应相关因素：一项为期四年的前瞻性队列研究
items.titleEn: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summaryZh: 在一项针对≥60岁创伤性巨大不可修复性肩袖撕裂（MIRCTs）老年患者的研究中，95-97%的患者在接受为期12周的非手术治疗（包括物理治疗）后，于3个月时达到最小临床重要差异，且效果持续至4年。症状持续时间延长和吸烟与功能较差相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This 4-year prospective cohort study indicates that most older adults with massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs) respond well to a 12-week nonoperative physical therapy program, with sustained improvements. Longer symptom duration and smoking were associated with poorer function, while diabetes linked to higher pain.
items.limitation: 需要进一步研究以确认与功能恢复轨迹相关的因素。
items.limitationEn: Further research is needed to confirm the findings regarding factors associated with functional recovery trajectories.

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: In chronic stroke patients (n=60), sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating EMG-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) combined with conventional therapy improved upper-limb function, spasticity, and strength significantly more than conventional therapy alone, with no difference between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中患者（n=60），感觉电刺激（SES）和交替式肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）联合常规治疗，在改善上肢功能、痉挛和肌力方面，显著优于单纯常规治疗，且两种电刺激方式效果无差别。
items.titleZh: 感觉电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激对慢性卒中患者上肢功能恢复的疗效比较：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summaryZh: 一项包含60名慢性卒中患者的随机对照试验显示，感觉电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）结合常规物理治疗，在改善上肢运动功能方面均显著优于单纯的常规治疗，且两种电刺激方法之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating EMG-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG), when added to conventional therapy, significantly improve upper-limb motor function in chronic stroke patients, with no significant difference between the two stimulation types. Both also reduced spasticity and improved muscle strength compared to control.
items.limitation: 研究纳入了中风后 6-18 个月的患者，这限制了其对更早或更晚阶段的推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study included patients 6-18 months post-stroke, limiting generalizability to earlier or later stages.

items.title: Do treatment parameters of dry needling influence its effect on pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (n=71 comparisons) found no dose-response relationship between dry needling parameters (sessions, muscles, twitch responses) and neck pain reduction, citing high heterogeneity and incomplete reporting.
items.curatedReason: 荟萃分析（n=71项研究）并未发现干针治疗参数（治疗频次、针刺肌肉数量、是否出现抽动反应）与颈痛缓解之间存在剂量效应关系。异质性高且报告不全，说明不了问题。
items.titleZh: 干针治疗参数是否影响其对疼痛的作用？一项系统性综述与荟萃分析
items.titleEn: Do treatment parameters of dry needling influence its effect on pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summaryZh: 一项系统性综述与荟萃分析（包含71项比较）发现，干针治疗的参数（如治疗次数、针刺肌肉数量、局部抽搐反应）与颈部疼痛缓解之间未发现剂量-反应关系，主要原因是研究中的异质性高且报告不完整。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis found no reliable evidence for a dose-response relationship between dry needling parameters (number of sessions, muscles treated, local twitch responses) and neck pain outcomes. Incomplete reporting and high heterogeneity limit conclusions, highlighting the need for more standardized research.
items.limitation: 所含研究的异质性高、报告不完整且存在较高的偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: Substantial heterogeneity, incomplete reporting, and high risk of bias in the included studies.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: Australia's physiotherapy workforce grew 70.5% from 2013-2023, but geographic maldistribution persisted with 81% in metro areas; males were less likely to practice rurally, while Indigenous physiotherapists were more likely.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师数量在2013-2023年间增长了70.5%，但81%仍集中在城市区域，地理分布不均的问题依然存在。必须设法激励更多治疗师进入乡村地区执业。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗劳动力趋势：变化及未来启示
items.titleEn: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summaryZh: 2013年至2023年间，澳大利亚注册物理治疗师数量增长了70.5%，但区域分布不均的问题依然存在，81%的从业者集中在都市地区。研究发现男性比女性更少在乡村地区执业，而原住民物理治疗师则更倾向于在乡村地区执业。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis of Australian physiotherapy workforce data from 2013-2023 reveals a significant increase in the number of physiotherapists but a persistent maldistribution, with over 81% practicing in metropolitan areas. Strategies are needed to incentivize rural and remote practice.
items.limitation: 未具体说明。
items.limitationEn: None specified.

items.title: A Machine Learning Model With Temporal Validation for Predicting Walking Ability in Nontraumatic Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A preliminary machine learning model developed from early clinical indicators (e.g., lower limb muscle strength, age) achieved promising accuracy (0.90 internal, 0.81 external validation) in predicting post-rehabilitation walking ability in non-traumatic spinal cord injury patients (n=148 training).
items.curatedReason: 这个基于早期肌力、年龄等指标的机器学习模型，在预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的康复后行走能力上，展现了初步的潜力，内部验证准确率0.90，外部验证0.81。虽然样本量不大，但提示我们或可借此工具，更早地为患者提供个性化的康复路径建议。
items.titleZh: 用于预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者行走能力的机器学习模型及其时间验证
items.titleEn: A Machine Learning Model With Temporal Validation for Predicting Walking Ability in Nontraumatic Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究开发并验证了一个基于早期临床指标（如下肢肌力、年龄）的机器学习模型，能有希望地预测非创伤性脊髓损伤（NTSCI）患者康复后的行走能力，内部验证准确率为0.90，外部验证为0.81。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary machine learning model, using early indicators like lower limb muscle strength and age, shows promising potential for predicting post-rehabilitation walking ability in non-traumatic SCI patients, with 0.90 internal and 0.81 external validation accuracy. While the sample size is small, it suggests a tool that could help tailor rehabilitation pathways earlier for patients.
items.limitation: 该模型需要在更大规模、多中心的队列中得到确认后才能临床应用。
items.limitationEn: The model requires confirmation in larger, multicenter cohorts before clinical application.

items.title: Sexual harassment experienced by nurses in a spinal Cord injury rehabilitation center.
items.summary: A survey found 87.5% of nurses in an SCI rehabilitation center experienced patient-perpetrated sexual harassment in the past 12 months, with verbal harassment being most common; training programs are recommended.
items.curatedReason: 某脊髓损伤康复中心护士调查显示，高达87.5%的护士在过去12个月内遭受过患者的性骚扰，以言语骚扰为主。必须设计针对性的培训，帮助她们应对。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤康复中心护士经历的性骚扰
items.titleEn: Sexual harassment experienced by nurses in a spinal Cord injury rehabilitation center.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤（SCI）康复中心护士的调查显示，过去12个月内，87.5%的护士经历过患者实施的性骚扰，其中言语骚扰最为常见；建议实施针对性的性骚扰培训项目。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey reveals a very high prevalence (87.5%) of patient-perpetrated sexual harassment, particularly verbal, experienced by nurses in a spinal cord injury (SCI) rehabilitation center. Targeted training programs are recommended to equip nurses with coping strategies.
items.limitation: 未具体说明。
items.limitationEn: None specified.

items.title: "It's important, but at a cost…": healthcare professionals and people with aphasia describe what influences use of a novel, digital communication aid.
items.summary: Healthcare professionals value communication aids for patients with aphasia but face systemic constraints hindering consistent use, necessitating multi-level system reform for effective adoption.
items.curatedReason: 医护人员认同失语症患者沟通辅助工具的价值，但现实中的系统性障碍阻碍了它们被持续使用。必须进行多层面的系统性改革，才能真正推广应用。
items.titleZh: “很重要，但有代价……”：医疗专业人员和失语症患者如何看待一种新型数字交流辅助工具的使用
items.titleEn: "It's important, but at a cost…": healthcare professionals and people with aphasia describe what influences use of a novel, digital communication aid.
items.summaryZh: 医疗专业人员（HCPs）认识到失语症（aphasia）患者沟通困难，并重视像“Aphasia App”这样的交流辅助工具，但由于医疗系统中的多重限制，其使用并不普遍，这表明需要进行多层级系统改革以支持其推广。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights that while healthcare professionals (HCPs) value communication aids like the 'Aphasia App' for patients with aphasia, systemic constraints within the healthcare system hinder their consistent use. Multi-level reform is needed to support adoption.
items.limitation: 样本量小（10 名 HCP，3 名 PWA）限制了其推广性。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size (10 HCPs, 3 PWAs) limits generalizability.

items.title: Appraisals of life transition events and associations with quality of life at 3- and 12-months post-discharge following spinal cord injury.
items.summary: Positive appraisals of life transition events and coping after SCI were associated with better QoL at 3 and 12 months post-discharge; clinicians should support self-efficacy for coping.
items.curatedReason: 脊髓损伤患者出院后3个月和12个月的QoL，与其对生活转变事件的积极认知和应对能力相关。临床医生应着力提升患者的自我效能感，帮助其更好地应对。
items.titleZh: 对生命转变事件的评价及其与脊髓损伤出院后3个月和12个月生活质量的关联
items.titleEn: Appraisals of life transition events and associations with quality of life at 3- and 12-months post-discharge following spinal cord injury.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤（SCI）患者的研究表明，对生命转变事件（如重返工作、驾车、家庭独立性）的积极评价及其应对能力，与出院后3个月和12个月的生活质量（QoL）呈正相关；临床医生应关注并支持患者的自我效能感。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that positive appraisals of life transition events and coping abilities after spinal cord injury (SCI) are associated with better quality of life (QoL) within the first year post-discharge. Clinicians should explore subjective meanings and support self-efficacy.
items.limitation: 样本量小且随访时间有限。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size and limited follow-up duration.

items.title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Parental Education in Physiotherapy Scale: A Brief Measure of Family-Centered Educational Practices in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
items.summary: The new 8-item Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale shows promising psychometric properties for assessing family-centered educational practices in pediatric physiotherapy, with a 3-factor structure (Collaboration, Capacity-Building, Reflection).
items.curatedReason: 这款简短的量表（PEP Scale）用于评估儿科物理治疗中以家庭为中心的教育实践，其多项心理测量学指标和三因素结构（协作、能力建设、反思）都显示出良好的应用前景，有助于临床实践的改进。
items.titleZh: 家长物理治疗教育量表（PEP）的心理测量学评价：一项儿科物理治疗中家庭中心教育实践的简短测量工具
items.titleEn: Psychometric Evaluation of the Parental Education in Physiotherapy Scale: A Brief Measure of Family-Centered Educational Practices in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
items.summaryZh: 一项研究开发并验证了家长物理治疗教育（PEP）量表，该量表是一个简短工具，用于评估儿科物理治疗中以家庭为中心的教育实践。该量表具有有前景的心理测量学特性，包括一个有效的3因素结构（协作、能力建设、反思）和良好的内部一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale, a brief measure assessing family-centered educational practices in pediatric physiotherapy, demonstrates promising psychometric properties, including a valid 3-factor structure (Collaboration, Capacity-Building, Reflection) and good internal consistency, facilitating professional reflection and quality improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究在西班牙进行，对象为 6 岁以下儿童。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in Spain and focused on children under 6 years of age.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: How Sensory and Motor Components Shape the Neurological Level of Injury
items.summary: This study investigates the contribution of sensory (light touch, pinprick) and motor components to determining neurological level of injury (NLI) and their impact on ASIA Impairment Scale classification.
items.curatedReason: 你应重新审视感觉（轻触、针刺）和运动成分在确定神经损伤平面（NLI）中的相对权重，这项研究提示它们对ASIA分级的影响可能被低估了。这并非小事，它直接关系到我们如何评估和分类脊髓损伤患者。
items.titleZh: 感觉和运动成分如何影响损伤的神经学水平
items.titleEn: How Sensory and Motor Components Shape the Neurological Level of Injury
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在评估轻触觉、针刺觉和运动功能在确定损伤神经学水平（NLI）中的作用，以及省略特定感觉成分如何影响分类，以指导循证建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: You should re-evaluate the relative contributions of sensory (light touch, pinprick) and motor components in determining the neurological level of injury (NLI). This study suggests their impact on ASIA Impairment Scale classification might be underestimated, which directly affects how we assess and classify patients with spinal cord injury.
items.limitation: 初步验证，需要进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: Preliminary validation, requires further study.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summary: Pilot/feasibility studies in stroke mobility rehabilitation show moderate reporting quality and low progression to RCTs (12%), with funding being the main barrier, highlighting a need for better design and support.
items.curatedReason: 卒中运动康复领域的初步/可行性研究，报告质量普遍不高，仅有12%的研究得以进入RCT阶段，主要障碍是资金缺乏。需要改进研究设计并加强资金支持，才能推动研究进展。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中初步和可行性研究：报告质量、向试验的进展及障碍：一项范围综述
items.titleEn: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述发现，卒中康复领域关于改善运动能力的初步和可行性研究，其报告质量中等，仅有12%的研究进展到明确的随机对照试验（RCT），主要障碍是缺乏资金。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review found that pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation for mobility often have moderate reporting quality and a low progression rate to definitive RCTs, primarily due to lack of funding. Improving study design and securing funding are crucial for advancing stroke rehabilitation research.
items.limitation: 向 RCT 进展率低，主要由于资金限制。
items.limitationEn: Low progression rate to RCTs, largely due to funding limitations.

items.title: Preliminary Validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Testing Rating Scale for Patients with Voice Disorders
items.summary: The Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) scale demonstrates preliminary validity for assessing multiple aspects of voice stimulability, predicting return to therapy.
items.curatedReason: MSP-V量表初步证实了其在评估嗓音可塑性方面的多维效度，能预测患者是否需要继续语音治疗。
items.titleZh: 声音障碍患者多维度刺激性测试评定量表的初步验证
items.titleEn: Preliminary Validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Testing Rating Scale for Patients with Voice Disorders
items.summaryZh: 多维度声音刺激性量表（MSP-V）显示出初步的内容、构念、同时效度和预测效度，可用于评估声音障碍患者刺激性测试的多个领域，并预测患者是否会返回语音治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) scale shows emerging content, construct, concurrent, and predictive validity for measuring multiple domains of stimulability testing in voice disorders, potentially improving documentation and research.
items.limitation: 初步验证，样本包含功能性、结构性和神经性声音障碍。
items.limitationEn: Preliminary validation, sample included functional, structural, and neurological voice disorders.

items.title: Feasibility and Measurement Properties of a Large Language Model-Based Virtual Patient Laboratory for Clinical Reasoning Training in Physical Therapy Students: Single-Arm Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study found an LLM-based virtual patient lab feasible for PT students, but LLM-generated clinical judgment scores showed poor correlation with human raters and clustered high, needing calibration before use.
items.curatedReason: LLM虚拟病人实验室可行，但其临床判断评分与人类评估者相关性差且偏高，需校准后方可用于PT学生培训。
items.titleZh: 基于大型语言模型的临床推理训练虚拟患者实验室的可行性及测量学特性：一项单臂试点研究
items.titleEn: Feasibility and Measurement Properties of a Large Language Model-Based Virtual Patient Laboratory for Clinical Reasoning Training in Physical Therapy Students: Single-Arm Pilot Study
items.summaryZh: 一项试点可行性研究发现，为物理治疗学生设计的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的虚拟患者实验室（LIA）是可行的，但LLM生成的临床判断评分与人类评估者评分的相关性较差，且分数偏高，表明需要进行校准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot feasibility study found that while implementing a Large Language Model (LLM)-based virtual patient laboratory (LIA) for physical therapy students was feasible, the LLM-generated clinical judgment scores did not correlate well with human assessments and clustered near maximum scores, indicating a need for calibration.
items.limitation: LLM 生成的分数与人类评估不相关；未来试验的样本量需要调整。
items.limitationEn: LLM-generated scores did not correlate with human assessments; sample size for future trial needs adjustment.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 studies (1177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training significantly improved the metabolic cost of walking (g = 0.40, p = 0.001) in healthy adults, with smaller non-significant effects in stroke patients, supporting its role in improving walking economy.
items.curatedReason: 慢性运动训练对健康人群步行代谢成本的改善效果是明确的 (g = 0.40, p = 0.001)。尽管卒中患者的改善不显著，但整体证据依然支持将运动经济性作为康复中的核心策略，尤其是对于旨在优化步行效率的患者，这是个值得推广的干预手段。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病人群步行代谢成本影响的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项研究（1177 名受试者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，慢性体力运动训练显著改善了健康成年人的步行代谢成本（g = 0.40, p = 0.001），对卒中患者的影响较小且不显著，支持其在改善步行经济性方面的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Chronic exercise training clearly improves the metabolic cost of walking in healthy adults (g = 0.40, p = 0.001). While effects were non-significant in stroke patients, the overall evidence still supports prioritizing walking economy in rehabilitation. This is an intervention you should consider for patients aiming to optimize walking efficiency.
items.limitation: 本研究纳入的神经系统疾病患者样本量较小，卒中患者的改善未达统计学显著，异质性中等。
items.limitationEn: The study included a small sample size of patients with neurological conditions, and improvements in stroke patients were not statistically significant, with moderate heterogeneity.
