items.title: Modality-specific, deficit-targeted exercise prescriptions for physical function in sarcopenia and frailty: a network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 61 RCTs (3706 participants) found that multicomponent training with resistance training provided the most comprehensive benefits for physical function in sarcopenia and frailty. Elastic band resistance training was most effective for handgrip strength (MD 1.95 kg, 95% CI 1.13 to 2.76, moderate certainty).
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 61 项 RCT 的网络荟萃分析指出，包含阻力训练的多成分训练方案为肌少症和衰弱症患者带来了最全面的功能获益。特定阻力模式，如弹力带训练，对握力有中等确定性的显著改善（1.95 kg）。这支持您采用针对性、多模式的运动处方。
items.titleZh: 肌少症和衰弱症患者身体功能的模式特异性、缺陷靶向运动处方：一项网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 61 项随机对照试验（3706 名参与者）的网络荟萃分析发现，多成分阻力训练为肌少症和衰弱症患者的身体功能带来了最全面的益处。弹力带阻力训练对握力最有效（平均差 1.95 公斤，95% CI 1.13 至 2.76，中等确定性）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis of 61 RCTs indicates that multicomponent training, including resistance training, offers the most comprehensive functional benefits for patients with sarcopenia and frailty. Specific resistance modalities, such as elastic band training, show moderately certain significant improvements in handgrip strength (1.95 kg). This supports your use of targeted, multimodal exercise prescriptions.
items.limitation: 虽然研究纳入 RCT 数量多，但多成分训练的证据确定性低，部分阻力模式如器械训练的证据确定性也较低。
items.limitationEn: Although the study included many RCTs, the certainty of evidence for multicomponent training and some resistance modalities like machine-based training was low.

items.title: From information to action; co-designing pain neuroscience education for adolescents with low back pain: Focus group insights.
items.summary: This qualitative study, involving 15 adolescents with low back pain in four focus groups, found that effective pain neuroscience education requires back-specific, practical, trustworthy, and engaging content tailored to young people's preferences, highlighting the importance of co-design.
items.curatedReason: 青少年下腰痛患者普遍认为，疼痛神经科学教育（PNE）材料必须具备相关性、实用性、可靠性，并以吸引人的格式呈现。在设计患者教育材料时，请务必让目标群体参与共创，确保信息能够真正转化为行动。
items.titleZh: 从信息到行动：与青少年下腰痛患者共同设计疼痛神经科学教育：焦点小组洞察
items.summaryZh: 这项对 15 名青少年下腰痛患者进行的四次焦点小组定性研究发现，有效的疼痛神经科学教育需要针对背部、实用、可信且以吸引青少年偏好的形式呈现的内容，强调了共同设计的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adolescents with low back pain consistently value pain neuroscience education (PNE) materials that are relatable, practical, trustworthy, and presented in an engaging format. When designing patient education materials, ensure active co-design with the target audience to facilitate information translation into action.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，结论的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: A multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy improves neuromuscular restoration and attenuates inflammatory and oxidative stress responses following a standardized football match: a randomized crossover study
items.summary: A randomized crossover study (n=20 male semi-professional football players) found that a modern multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy (very low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, percussive therapy) significantly improved neuromuscular restoration and attenuated inflammatory/oxidative stress markers post-match compared to passive recovery, with outcome-specific differences from traditional active recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，多模式非疲劳性恢复策略（如极低强度骑行、泡沫滚压和冲击疗法）比传统主动跑步或被动恢复更能支持短期神经肌肉恢复，并减轻足球比赛后的生化紊乱。您可以考虑将其整合到运动队的赛后恢复方案中。
items.titleZh: 多模式非疲劳性恢复策略在标准化足球比赛后改善神经肌肉恢复并减轻炎症和氧化应激反应：一项随机交叉研究
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉研究（20 名半专业男足球运动员）发现，现代多模式非疲劳性恢复策略（极低强度骑行、泡沫滚压、冲击疗法）与被动恢复相比，能显著改善赛后神经肌肉恢复并减轻炎症/氧化应激标志物，与传统主动恢复的差异则取决于具体结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that a multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy (e.g., very low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, and percussive therapy) may better support short-term neuromuscular recovery and attenuate biochemical disturbances after a football match compared to traditional active running or passive recovery. Consider integrating this into your sports teams' post-match recovery protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=20），且未前瞻性注册临床试验，部分结果在多模式与传统主动恢复间未显示持续性优势，需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=20), was not prospectively registered, and some results did not consistently show an advantage of multimodal over traditional active recovery, requiring cautious interpretation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Return to Competition and Career Sustainability After Primary ACL Reconstruction in Football: A Nationwide Cohort Study of Long-Term Participation
items.summary: A decade-long nationwide cohort study of 10,836 Swedish football players found that 58.5% achieved return to competition (RTC) after primary ACLR, but long-term participation was often limited (median 31 matches over 3 seasons) and strongly associated with pre-injury competitive level and sex.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模队列研究显示，足球运动员 ACLR 术后重返赛场（RTC）率较高，但职业生涯持续性（参赛场次和赛季）往往有限，且与术前竞技水平密切相关。您在与患者讨论重返运动目标时，应超越单纯的 RTC，更全面评估其长期参与的可持续性。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后重返赛场和职业生涯可持续性：一项长期参与的全国性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10,836 名瑞典足球运动员的十年全国队列研究发现，初次 ACLR 后 58.5% 的运动员重返赛场 (RTC)，但长期参与通常有限（3 个赛季中位数为 31 场比赛），并且与术前竞技水平和性别密切相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cohort study reveals that football players frequently return to competition (RTC) after ACLR, but long-term career sustainability (matches and seasons played) is often limited and strongly linked to pre-injury competitive level. When discussing return-to-sport goals with patients, you should look beyond just RTC and comprehensively assess long-term participation sustainability.
items.limitation: 本研究基于瑞典全国性数据，结论可能不完全适用于其他国家或地区的不同运动项目和医疗系统。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on nationwide Swedish data, and its conclusions may not be fully applicable to other countries or regions with different sports and healthcare systems.

items.title:
Effectiveness of physical, psychological, and alternative interventions for post-COVID-19 condition: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 27 RCTs (1998 participants) found that supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise consistently improved cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in post-COVID-19 condition, while cognitive-behavioral therapy reduced fatigue. However, most trials had a high risk of bias.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动对改善新冠后遗症患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力有显著益处，认知行为疗法（CBT）也能有效减轻疲劳和注意力问题。您可以将这些干预措施纳入临床实践，但请注意许多研究的偏倚风险较高。
items.titleZh: 物理、心理和替代干预措施对新冠后遗症的有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项随机对照试验（1998 名参与者）的系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动持续改善了新冠后遗症患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力，而认知行为疗法则减轻了疲劳。然而，大多数试验存在高偏倚风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found significant benefits of supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise for improving cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in post-COVID-19 patients, with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) also effective in reducing fatigue and concentration issues. You can incorporate these interventions into clinical practice, but be aware of the high risk of bias in many studies.
items.limitation: 多数纳入研究存在高偏倚风险，样本量小且随访期短，且因异质性未能进行荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: Most included studies had a high risk of bias, small sample sizes, and short follow-up periods, and meta-analysis was not performed due to heterogeneity.

items.title: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summary: An APTA podcast discusses AI's impact on physical therapist practice and payment, focusing on how AI can reduce administrative burden, improve documentation and billing, identify payment trends, and allow clinicians to spend more time on patient care. It aims to demystify AI for PT/PTA professionals.
items.curatedReason: 你必须开始了解 AI 在物理治疗中的实际应用，它能帮你减轻行政负担、优化文档和账单，从而把更多时间留给患者。这个播客能帮你快速入门，明确 AI 如何改变实践和支付模式，你不需要成为 AI 专家，但绝不能对此一无所知。
items.titleZh: 探索 AI 对物理治疗实践和支付的影响 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 的一期播客探讨了 AI 对物理治疗实践和支付的影响，重点关注 AI 如何减少行政负担、改进文档和账单处理、识别支付趋势，并让临床医生将更多时间投入到患者护理中。它旨在为物理治疗师专业人士揭开 AI 的神秘面纱。
items.curatedReasonEn: You need to start understanding AI's practical applications in physical therapy; it can reduce your administrative burden and optimize documentation/billing, freeing up more time for patients. This podcast helps you quickly grasp how AI is changing practice and payment models. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you absolutely cannot afford to remain uninformed.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) Accreditation Committee has published "Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation" to guide flexible and innovative health practitioner education, address workforce challenges, and promote continuous quality improvement in Australia.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 发布了“基于结果的认证方法原则”。这些原则旨在指导认证机构采用更灵活和创新的教育评估方式，以应对劳动力挑战并鼓励持续质量改进。这可能影响澳大利亚物理治疗师的教育和执业路径。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 - 基于结果的认证方法使用原则
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（AHPRA）认证委员会发布了《基于结果的认证方法使用原则》，旨在指导灵活和创新的健康从业者教育，应对劳动力挑战，并促进澳大利亚的持续质量改进。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has published "Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation." These principles aim to guide accreditation authorities in adopting more flexible and innovative educational assessment methods to address workforce challenges and encourage continuous quality improvement. This may affect the education and practice pathways for physical therapists in Australia.

items.title: The effect of adding virtual reality-based rehabilitation to conventional physiotherapy on pain, function and static balance control in patients with total knee arthroplasty during the acute rehabilitation phase: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=52) found that adding virtual reality (VR)-based therapy to conventional physiotherapy in the acute phase after total knee arthroplasty significantly improved WOMAC scores and pain (p < 0.001, η² = 0.36), and static balance compared to conventional therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，全膝关节置换术（TKA）急性康复期在常规理疗中加入 VR 治疗，能显著改善疼痛、功能和静态平衡，WOMAC 评分改善更显著（p < 0.001, η² = 0.36）。这为 TKA 术后早期康复提供了有力的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术急性康复期在常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实康复对疼痛、功能和静态平衡控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=52）发现，在全膝关节置换术后急性期康复中，除了常规物理治疗，额外加入虚拟现实（VR）疗法能显著改善 WOMAC 评分和疼痛（p < 0.001, η² = 0.36）以及静态平衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that adding VR-based therapy to conventional physiotherapy during the acute rehabilitation phase of total knee arthroplasty (TKA) significantly improves pain, function, and static balance, with more pronounced WOMAC score improvements (p < 0.001, η² = 0.36). This offers a powerful adjunctive tool for early TKA rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小且随访期短，未来需要多中心、大样本、长随访试验进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a relatively small sample size and short follow-up period, requiring future multicenter trials with larger samples and longer follow-up for further validation.

items.title: Promoting arm movement practice with a novel wheelchair armrest early after stroke: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=35) found that a novel wheelchair armrest device (Boost) was feasible for promoting thousands of self-directed upper extremity movements in stroke inpatients, showing a trend towards greater UEFM improvement (11.8 vs. 6.9 points) post-intervention and significant gains for less severe impairment subgroups (15.8 vs. 7.8 points).
items.curatedReason: 尽管 Boost 轮椅扶手装置在卒中早期康复中未能显著改善上肢功能，但它确实提高了患者自行完成上肢运动的次数。对于那些病情较轻的患者，它显示出潜在的短期益处（出院时 UEFM 评分提升 15.8 vs. 7.8 分），值得后续大规模试验的进一步验证。
items.titleZh: 卒中早期使用新型轮椅扶手促进手臂运动实践：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=35）发现，在卒中住院患者中，新型轮椅扶手装置（Boost）可行地促进了数千次自主上肢运动，干预后 UEFM 改善有更大趋势（11.8 vs. 6.9 分），对于较轻障碍亚组有显著改善（15.8 vs. 7.8 分）。
items.curatedReasonEn: While the Boost wheelchair armrest device did not significantly improve upper extremity function in early stroke rehabilitation, it did enable patients to complete thousands of self-directed arm movements. For less severely impaired patients, it showed potential short-term benefits (UEFM gain of 15.8 vs. 7.8 points at discharge), warranting further evaluation in larger trials.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=35），随访时间较短，且未发现组间临床结局的显著差异，结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=35), short follow-up, and found no significant between-group clinical differences, requiring cautious interpretation of the results.

items.title: What’s Behind the Label? Rethinking Exercise Prescription for Tendinopathy - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: This BJSM blog post argues that exercise prescription for tendinopathy should move beyond generic labels (e.g., eccentric, isometric) to detailed documentation of the "mechanical dose," including actual load, effort, repetitions, tempo, range, and patient response, to improve clinical reasoning and reporting.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调，肌腱病变康复中，不应仅仅记录“离心、等长、慢速大负荷”等笼统的运动名称，而应详细记录实际负荷、次数、速度、范围和患者反应等具体“机械剂量”。这有助于您更精准地评估干预效果并调整方案。
items.titleZh: 标签背后是什么？重新思考肌腱病变的运动处方
items.summaryZh: 这篇 BJSM 博客文章认为，肌腱病变的运动处方应超越笼统的标签（如离心、等长），转向详细记录“机械剂量”，包括实际负荷、努力程度、重复次数、节奏、范围和患者反应，以改进临床推理和报告。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary emphasizes that in tendinopathy rehabilitation, you should not just record general exercise names like "eccentric, isometric, or heavy slow resistance," but rather detailed "mechanical doses" such as actual load, repetitions, speed, range, and patient response. This will help you more accurately evaluate intervention effectiveness and adjust treatment plans.

items.title: Effects of resistance training intensity and a dietary protein intervention on psychosocial outcomes, executive function, and quality of life in frail community-dwelling older adults
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT (n=295 frail older adults) found that 12 weeks of supervised resistance training improved depressive symptoms (β = −0.167), executive function, and quality of life (β = +1.26), with no consistent differences across training intensities or additional benefits from protein intervention.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 二次分析表明，衰弱的社区老年人经过 12 周阻力训练后，抑郁症状、执行功能和生活质量均有改善。训练强度对这些益处没有持续性影响，蛋白质干预也未带来一致的额外益处。在制定老年人康复方案时，您可以更多关注阻力训练本身而非强度细节。
items.titleZh: 阻力训练强度和膳食蛋白质干预对衰弱社区老年人心理社会结局、执行功能和生活质量的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=295 名衰弱老年人）的二次分析发现，12 周监督阻力训练改善了抑郁症状（β = -0.167）、执行功能和生活质量（β = +1.26），但训练强度和蛋白质干预未带来持续性差异或额外益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis of an RCT indicates that frail community-dwelling older adults showed improved depressive symptoms, executive function, and quality of life after 12 weeks of resistance training. Training intensity did not consistently influence these benefits, and protein intervention offered no consistent additional advantages. When designing rehabilitation programs for older adults, you can focus more on resistance training itself rather than intensity specifics.
items.limitation: 本研究是二次分析，结果具有探索性质，且研究存在行业资助。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary analysis, making its findings exploratory, and it received industry funding.

items.title: Factors associated with 1-year health-related quality of life after neck-specific exercise in chronic whiplash-associated disorders: an exploratory secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: An exploratory secondary analysis of an RCT (n=140) found that improvements in psychosocial measures, pain, and disability were associated with HRQoL improvements after neck-specific exercise for chronic whiplash-associated disorders. Higher baseline adverse psychosocial measures and disability predicted clinically relevant HRQoL improvement at 15 months (R² = 0.26, Q² = 0.13).
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性颈部挥鞭伤患者，那些基线心理社会因素更差、残疾程度更高的，反而更有可能在颈部特异性运动后获得临床显著的 HRQoL 改善。在评估这类患者时，别只盯着躯体症状，更要全面考虑他们的心理社会状况，这可能是预测预后和优化干预的关键。
items.titleZh: 慢性挥鞭伤相关疾病患者颈部特异性运动后 1 年健康相关生活质量的影响因素：一项随机对照试验的探索性二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=140）的探索性二次分析发现，颈部特异性运动后，心理社会指标、疼痛和残疾的改善与健康相关生活质量的改善相关。基线心理社会指标较差和残疾程度较高预示着 15 个月时健康相关生活质量的临床显著改善（R² = 0.26, Q² = 0.13）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with chronic whiplash-associated disorders who start with worse psychosocial measures and higher disability are actually more likely to achieve clinically significant HRQoL improvements after neck-specific exercise. When assessing these patients, don't just focus on physical symptoms; a comprehensive view of their psychosocial status may be key to predicting outcomes and optimizing interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性二次分析，模型预测能力较弱，结论仅为假设生成。
items.limitationEn: This study is an exploratory secondary analysis with weak model predictive ability, and the conclusions are hypothesis-generating only.

items.title: Effect of lumbar strengthening exercises on kinesiophobia in people with chronic low back pain: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of three RCTs concluded that very-low-certainty evidence is insufficient to determine the effectiveness of lumbar strengthening exercises alone in reducing kinesiophobia in individuals with chronic non-specific low back pain, highlighting inconsistent findings and methodological concerns.
items.curatedReason: 关于腰部强化运动能否降低慢性下腰痛患者运动恐惧的证据，仍处于“非常低确定性”级别。虽然有研究显示某些形式的强化训练有益，但尚不足以改变临床常规。在提供干预时，请继续将心理社会因素纳入全面考量。
items.titleZh: 腰部强化锻炼对慢性下腰痛患者运动恐惧症影响的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含三项随机对照试验的系统综述指出，极低质量证据不足以确定单纯腰部强化训练在减轻慢性非特异性下腰痛患者运动恐惧症方面的有效性，并强调了结果的不一致性和方法学问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence on whether lumbar strengthening exercises reduce kinesiophobia in chronic low back pain remains at a "very low certainty" level. While some studies suggest benefits, it's not enough to alter routine clinical practice. Continue to integrate psychosocial factors into comprehensive interventions.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入 3 项 RCT，其中 1 项存在高偏倚风险，2 项存在方法学问题，证据确定性非常低。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only 3 RCTs, with one at high risk of bias and two with methodological concerns, leading to very low certainty of evidence.

items.title: Intermittent theta burst stimulation on the cerebellar Hemisphere to imprOve Post-stroke cognitivE impairment (HOPE): a multicentre randomised controlled double-blind trial
items.summary: This multicenter randomized controlled double-blind trial protocol (HOPE trial) aims to investigate the safety and efficacy of intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) on the cerebellar hemisphere to improve cognitive function in 70 adults with post-stroke cognitive impairment within 14 days of a first-ever unilateral ischemic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项关于卒中后认知障碍（PSCI）的随机对照试验方案。该试验将评估小脑间歇性 θ 爆发刺激（iTBS）的安全性与疗效。这可能会为 PSCI 的早期神经调控提供新的策略，但目前仅是协议阶段，期待其未来的发现。
items.titleZh: 小脑半球间歇性θ爆发刺激改善卒中后认知障碍（HOPE）：一项多中心随机对照双盲试验
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心随机对照双盲试验（HOPE 试验）方案旨在研究对小脑半球进行间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）改善卒中后认知功能的安全性和有效性，该试验将招募 70 名首次单侧缺血性卒中后 14 天内出现认知障碍的成年人。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an RCT protocol for post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI), which will evaluate the safety and efficacy of cerebellar intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS). This may offer a new neuromodulation strategy for early PSCI, but it is currently only a protocol, and its future findings are anticipated.
items.limitation: 这是一项试验方案，尚未产生临床数据或结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a trial protocol and has not yet produced clinical data or conclusions.

items.title: Physical Therapy in the News: September 2026
items.summary: APTA's "Physical Therapy in the News: September 2026" is a monthly series highlighting recent media coverage of the physical therapy profession and APTA members.
items.curatedReason: APTA 发布了其“物理治疗新闻”月度摘要。您可以阅读以快速了解上个月美国物理治疗行业的媒体关注点和重要动态。
items.titleZh: 2026 年 9 月物理治疗新闻 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 的“物理治疗新闻”是一个月度系列，重点报道物理治疗行业和 APTA 会员的最新媒体动态。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released its monthly "Physical Therapy in the News" summary for September 2026. You can read it to quickly catch up on last month's media coverage and key developments in the US physical therapy profession.

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy-a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study of 15,197 individuals with knee or hip OA found that a digital education and exercise therapy program increased the proportion of participants meeting recommended physical activity levels from 51.4% at enrolment to 58.5% at one year, with comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes across all PA trajectories.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型注册研究证实，针对髋膝骨关节炎患者的数字教育和运动疗法项目，能有效提高近六成患者的身体活动水平。特别注意 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者，他们可能需要更个性化的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 数字教育与运动疗法后髋膝骨关节炎患者身体活动轨迹：一项对 15,197 人的长期注册研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 名髋膝骨关节炎患者的长期注册研究显示，数字教育和运动疗法项目使达到推荐身体活动水平的患者比例从基线的 51.4% 增至一年时的 58.5%。所有身体活动轨迹的患者在患者报告结局方面均有可比的临床改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large registry study confirms that digital education and exercise therapy programs can effectively increase physical activity in nearly 60% of patients with knee or hip osteoarthritis. Pay special attention to patients with higher BMI and poorer function, who may benefit from more targeted interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性注册研究，无法建立干预与身体活动轨迹之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational registry study, and thus cannot establish causality between the intervention and physical activity trajectories.

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH) program is a complex intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes, including mild to moderate cognitive changes, low mood, anxiety, and fatigue, within a UK matched care model.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 项目为卒中后心理变化的自我管理提供了一种结构化的支持方案，它通过分层护理模式，将轻中度患者纳入支持范围，同时将重度患者转诊，这在提升 UK 卒中社区护理的心理健康支持方面迈出了重要一步。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化增强型评估（ENRICH）的开发：一项在分层护理模型中监测和支持卒中后心理变化自我管理的复杂干预
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化增强型评估（ENRICH）项目是一项复杂干预，旨在英国分层护理模型中监测和支持卒中后心理变化的自我管理，包括轻中度认知改变、情绪低落、焦虑和疲劳。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH program offers a structured support solution for self-managing post-stroke psychological changes. By integrating a matched care model, it includes those with mild to moderate changes while referring severe cases, marking a significant step in enhancing mental health support in UK stroke community care.
items.limitation: 本研究仅报告了 ENRICH 项目的设计和开发过程，尚未进行临床有效性测试。
items.limitationEn: This study only reports the design and development of the ENRICH program, with clinical effectiveness testing planned for the future.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: This review describes the current state of ACL reconstruction (ACLR), noting shifts in graft utilization towards quadriceps tendon autograft, support for lateral extra-articular tenodesis in high-risk knees, and a move from fixed timelines to criteria-based clearance for return-to-play, integrating functional and psychological readiness.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了 ACLR 领域在移植物选择、侧方加固、康复和重返运动实践方面的最新进展。移植物选择应个性化，侧方加固限于高风险病例，而重返运动标准强调功能和心理准备，而非单纯时间线，这提示你应更全面地评估患者。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、侧方加固、康复与重返运动
items.summaryZh: 该综述阐述了前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）的现状，指出移植物选择转向股四头肌腱自体移植物，高风险膝关节支持外侧关节外腱固定术，以及重返运动从固定时间线转向基于功能和心理准备的评估标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review summarizes current advancements in ACLR, covering graft selection, lateral augmentation, rehabilitation, and return-to-play. Graft selection should be individualized, lateral augmentation reserved for high-risk cases, and return-to-play criteria should emphasize function and psychological readiness over fixed timelines, prompting you to conduct more comprehensive patient assessments.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未提供系统评价或荟萃分析的证据等级。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and does not provide evidence grading typical of systematic reviews or meta-analyses.

items.title: Development of a Communication Characteristics Module for Autistic Adults and the Creation of a Communication Profile Variable
items.summary: Researchers developed and validated a 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for autistic adults using a community-based participatory research approach. The module demonstrated high feasibility and strong construct validity, providing a valid tool for characterizing communication diversity in research, clinical, and service settings.
items.curatedReason: 我们现在有了一个经验证的10项沟通特征模块和五级沟通概况变量，用于评估自闭症成年人的沟通多样性。这有助于我们更精准地理解和描述自闭症成年人在不同情境下的沟通方式，而非仅仅停留在诊断层面。
items.titleZh: 自闭症成年人沟通特征模块的开发及沟通概况变量的创建
items.summaryZh: 研究人员采用社区参与式研究方法，开发并验证了一个包含 10 个项目的自闭症成年人沟通特征模块和一个五级沟通概况变量。该模块在可行性和结构效度方面表现出色，为研究、临床和服务环境中表征沟通多样性提供了有效工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: We now have a validated 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for assessing communication diversity in autistic adults. This tool will help us more precisely understand and describe the communication styles of autistic adults across various settings, moving beyond a sole diagnostic focus.
items.limitation: 本研究基于自闭症成年人的自我报告数据，可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on self-reported data from autistic adults, which may introduce reporting bias.

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: Adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) provided no clinically important additional improvements in pain intensity (MD -0.4 points), disability (MD -0.7 points), or circulating PGE2 concentrations compared to sham PBMT plus MCE in 148 adults with chronic non-specific low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 发现，慢性非特异性腰痛患者在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法 (PBMT) 并未带来额外的临床益处。这意味着 PBMT 仍不应作为一线或常规辅助方案。
items.titleZh: 光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练辅助手段对慢性非特异性腰痛患者的疗效微乎其微：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 148 名慢性非特异性腰痛成年患者的随机对照试验显示，与安慰剂加运动控制训练相比，光生物调节疗法 (PBMT) 联合运动控制训练在改善疼痛强度（平均差 -0.4 分）、残疾（平均差 -0.7 分）或循环 PGE2 浓度方面未提供临床上显著的额外改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise provided no additional clinical benefits for chronic non-specific low back pain. This suggests PBMT should not be adopted as a first-line or routine adjunct therapy.
items.limitation: 本研究的长期随访结果显示了与主要结局相似的趋势，但仍需更多研究来完全排除小效应的可能性。
items.limitationEn: Although long-term follow-up showed similar trends, more research is needed to fully rule out the possibility of small effects.

items.title: Efficacy of physiotherapy in reducing pain in subjects with temporomandibular disorders: a systematic review with network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 25 RCTs (1,540 people) found that manual therapy and therapeutic exercise are effective for reducing pain in temporomandibular disorders (TMDs), with multimodal treatments, particularly the combination of dry needling and manual therapy, appearing most effective.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析支持手法治疗和治疗性运动在颞下颌关节紊乱病 (TMD) 疼痛管理中作为一线干预。您可以优先考虑多模式治疗，特别是干针与手法治疗结合，以获得最佳疼痛缓解效果。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗在减少颞下颌关节紊乱病患者疼痛中的疗效：一项网络荟萃分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 25 项随机对照试验（1,540 人）的网络荟萃分析发现，手法治疗和治疗性运动在减少颞下颌关节紊乱病 (TMDs) 患者疼痛方面有效，其中多模式治疗，特别是干针与手法治疗的结合，效果最佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis supports manual therapy and therapeutic exercise as first-line interventions for temporomandibular disorders (TMD) pain management. You should prioritize multimodal treatments, especially the combination of dry needling and manual therapy, for optimal pain relief.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量存在较大差异（PEDro 评分 3-9 分），这可能影响网络荟萃分析结果的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies showed significant heterogeneity in methodological quality (PEDro scores 3-9), which may affect the robustness of the network meta-analysis results.

items.title: Early Changes in Post-Stroke Quality of Life and Associated Factors: A Prospective Study.
items.summary: In stroke patients, physical HRQoL improved progressively for 3 months, while mental HRQoL improved only in the first month. Functional ambulation was associated with physical HRQoL change (β = 0.483, p < 0.001), and depressive symptoms with mental HRQoL change (β = -0.692, p < 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期生理和心理社会生活质量的恢复路径并不一致。在康复计划中，您应同时关注患者的步行能力和抑郁症状，因为它们与不同维度的生活质量改善独立相关。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期生活质量变化及相关因素：一项前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 在卒中患者中，生理生活质量在 3 个月内持续改善，而心理生活质量仅在第一个月改善。3 个月时的功能性步行与生理生活质量变化独立相关 (β = 0.483, p < 0.001)，而抑郁症状严重程度与心理生活质量变化独立相关 (β = -0.692, p < 0.001)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early recovery trajectories for physical and psychosocial quality of life post-stroke are divergent. In rehabilitation planning, you should separately address functional ambulation and depressive symptoms, as they are independently associated with different dimensions of HRQoL improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性研究，结果可能受限于特定人群和医疗环境，外推至其他人群和情境需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective study, so its findings may be limited to the specific population and healthcare setting and should be extrapolated with caution.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: A narrative review highlights five themes in pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research from 2021-2026: improved access and uptake strategies, expanded evidence beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, emergence of alternative PR models, importance of maintenance strategies post-PR, and growing evidence for PR's economic benefits.
items.curatedReason: 肺康复的适用范围已显著扩展，远超稳定期 COPD，非中心模式和经济效益的证据也在增多。你需要推动肺康复的普及，并可考虑将中心化之外的模式纳入实践，但也要记住PR后的维持策略至关重要。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究最新进展亮点
items.summaryZh: 一份叙述性综述总结了 2021-2026 年肺康复 (PR) 研究的五个关键主题：改善 PR 可及性和参与度的策略、PR 证据范围从稳定期 COPD 扩展到多种慢性呼吸系统疾病、替代 PR 模式的出现、PR 完成后维持效益的重要性，以及 PR 经济效益日益增长的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pulmonary rehabilitation's scope has significantly expanded beyond stable COPD, with increasing evidence for diverse delivery models and economic benefits. You should advocate for broader PR access and consider incorporating non-center-based models, but always remember the critical importance of post-PR maintenance strategies.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性质量评估，因此结论的证据等级低于系统综述。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, this may be subject to selection bias and lacks systematic quality assessment, making its evidence level lower than that of systematic reviews.

items.title: "It's a black box": Physiotherapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control and the use of technology in this context to improve rehabilitation following ACL injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 22 physiotherapists found interest in technology for sensorimotor assessment and rehabilitation after ACL injury, but adoption is limited by uncertainty regarding clinical value and integration with workflows.
items.curatedReason: ACL 康复专家认同技术可辅助感觉运动控制评估与训练，但对其临床价值和整合到工作流程中的方式仍有疑问。这意味着您在考虑引入新技术时，要优先考虑其明确的临床效益和与现有流程的兼容性。
items.titleZh: “这是一个黑箱”：物理治疗师对感觉运动控制及技术在 ACL 损伤康复中应用的看法
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 22 名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，他们对 ACL 损伤后的感觉运动评估和康复技术感兴趣，但由于对临床价值和工作流程整合的不确定性，采纳程度受到限制。
items.curatedReasonEn: ACL rehabilitation experts acknowledge technology can aid sensorimotor control assessment and training, but questions remain about its clinical value and integration into workflows. This means that when considering new technologies, you should prioritize clear clinical benefits and compatibility with existing workflows.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性设计，样本量较小（22 名物理治疗师），结果主要反映受访者的主观感知和经验，不具备普遍量化性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study involved a small sample of 22 physiotherapists, and its findings primarily reflect subjective perceptions and experiences, lacking quantitative generalizability.

items.title: Fall prevention interventions among older adults in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs): an integrative review.
items.summary: An integrative review of 14 studies from LMICs found that multifactorial interventions, exercise-based programs, and home safety modifications were associated with reductions in fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults.
items.curatedReason: 在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），多因素干预、运动和家庭安全改造可降低老年人跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧。您在这些地区开展跌倒预防工作时，应将高收入国家经验进行本地化适应。
items.titleZh: 低收入和中等收入国家老年人跌倒预防干预措施：一项综合性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 14 项来自低收入和中等收入国家研究的综合性综述发现，多因素干预、运动方案和家庭安全改造与老年人跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧的降低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: In low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), multifactorial interventions, exercise, and home safety modifications can reduce fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults. When implementing fall prevention in these regions, you should adapt high-income country experiences to local contexts.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究数量有限（14 项），且干预措施和测量结局存在异质性，因此结论的普遍性和确定性受限。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (14) and heterogeneity in interventions and outcomes restrict the generalizability and certainty of the conclusions.

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: In a 12-week cardiac rehabilitation program with 71 participants, short-rest interval resistance training (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set resistance training (3×9 RT) similarly improved VO₂peak, sit-to-stand performance, and total lean mass. Quadriceps strength improved more with 3/7 RT (+23±20 N·m vs +11±22 N·m; P=0.022 for isokinetic strength).
items.curatedReason: 在心脏康复项目中，短间歇阻力训练（3/7 RT）与传统多组阻力训练（3×9 RT）在改善 VO₂peak、坐站表现和去脂体重方面效果相似。考虑到患者偏好，您可以灵活选择训练方案，两种方式在临床实践中均可行。
items.titleZh: 短间歇与传统多组阻力训练结合耐力训练对心血管疾病患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 71 名参与者的 12 周心脏康复随机临床试验显示，短间歇阻力训练（3/7 RT）与传统多组阻力训练（3×9 RT）在改善峰值摄氧量、坐站表现和去脂体重方面效果相似。然而，3/7 RT 在等速股四头肌力量方面改善更显著（+23±20 N·m vs +11±22 N·m；P=0.022）。
items.curatedReasonEn: In cardiac rehabilitation, short-rest interval resistance training (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set resistance training (3×9 RT) similarly improve VO₂peak, sit-to-stand performance, and lean mass. You can flexibly choose training protocols based on patient preference, as both are feasible in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量为 71 例，可能不足以完全捕捉两种训练方案在所有结局指标上的细微差异。
items.limitationEn: The sample size of 71 participants may be insufficient to fully capture subtle differences between the two training protocols across all outcome measures.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: A case series study of 100 patients after quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction found that early postoperative limb symmetry index (LSI) scores, particularly 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI, independently predicted 2-year patient-reported outcomes (IKDC and Lysholm scores). Patients achieving IKDC PASS generally attained a 60% to 70% LSI score by 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 髌腱自移植物 ACL 重建术后，3 个月时的等长股四头肌 LSI 评分可以有效预测 2 年 IKDC 评分，9 个月时的等速股四头肌 LSI 评分则可预测 IKDC 和 Lysholm 评分。在您指导患者术后康复时，早期股四头肌力量恢复应是重点，并可参考 60%-70% LSI 作为早期功能恢复的 PASS 阈值。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌腱自移植物 ACL 重建术后早期肢体对称性指数评分与 2 年患者报告结局之间的关联。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 100 名股四头肌腱自移植物 ACL 重建术患者的病例系列研究发现，术后早期肢体对称性指数（LSI）评分，特别是 3 个月时的等长股四头肌 LSI，能独立预测 2 年患者报告结局（IKDC 和 Lysholm 评分）。达到 IKDC 患者可接受症状状态（PASS）的患者通常在 3 个月时达到 60% 至 70% 的 LSI 评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: After quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction, 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI scores predict 2-year IKDC scores, and 9-month isokinetic quadriceps LSI scores predict both IKDC and Lysholm scores. When guiding patients through rehabilitation, prioritize early quadriceps strength recovery, using 60-70% LSI as a PASS threshold for early function.
items.limitation: 这是一项病例系列研究，证据等级为 4，可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This is a case series study, level of evidence 4, which may be subject to selection bias and confounding factors.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=75) on post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome found that both high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) and extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises improved nerve conduction and upper-limb function more than UNGE alone. HILT demonstrated superior electrophysiological (ulnar motor nerve conduction velocity, CMAP amplitudes) and functional (DASH scores) outcomes compared to ESWT, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 对于烧伤后肘管综合征，结合尺神经滑动练习，高强度激光治疗（HILT）在改善神经传导和上肢功能方面优于体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）。这一发现支持在您的临床实践中，HILT 作为辅助治疗可带来更显著的电生理和功能改善，并在 12 周随访中保持疗效。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征高强度激光治疗与体外冲击波治疗的电生理和功能反应比较：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对烧伤后肘管综合征的随机对照试验（N=75）发现，高强度激光治疗（HILT）和体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）联合尺神经滑动练习，在改善神经传导和上肢功能方面均优于单独的神经滑动练习。其中，HILT 在电生理指标（尺神经运动传导速度、复合肌肉动作电位幅度）和功能（DASH 评分）方面均优于 ESWT，且疗效在 12 周随访中保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome, high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises (UNGE) demonstrated superior improvements in nerve conduction and upper limb function compared to extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT). This finding supports integrating HILT into your clinical practice for more significant electrophysiological and functional gains, sustained at 12-week follow-up.
items.limitation: 研究未报告烧伤严重程度和病程，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report the severity and duration of burns, which might affect the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that 45% adhered to home-based exercise therapy. Higher pre-cLBP physical activity, lower pain intensity, and lower treatment burden were associated with better adherence, but supervision did not significantly influence it.
items.curatedReason: 针对非特异性慢性腰痛患者，居家运动依从性研究表明，仅 45% 的患者能坚持。尽管监督是常见干预，但该研究未发现其对依从性的显著影响，提示需重新思考居家方案设计。
items.titleZh: 非特异性慢性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：ComPaRE cLBP 电子队列 491 名参与者的横断面研究 (ADHERE II)。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 491 名非特异性慢性腰痛成人进行的横断面研究发现，居家运动治疗依从性为 45%。较高水平的病前身体活动、较低的腰痛强度和较低的治疗负担与较高的依从性相关，但监督未显示出显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adults with non-specific chronic low back pain, this study found only 45% adherence to home-based exercise. Despite common belief, supervision did not significantly influence adherence, suggesting a need to rethink home program design.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且依从性数据来自患者自报。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and adherence data were self-reported by participants.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A scoping review of 65 randomized controlled trials on continuity of care interventions for stroke patients and caregivers found that most interventions focused on transitions from acute inpatient to home care, often excluding caregivers. It emphasizes the need for family-centered approaches across the entire care continuum.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者康复，照护连续性至关重要。该综述提示，当前干预多集中于急性期到居家，且较少同时关注患者和照护者。您在设计康复路径时，应主动纳入更多过渡阶段和家庭照护者支持。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者及其照护者的照护连续性干预：一项随机对照试验的范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对卒中患者及照护者照护连续性干预的范围综述，纳入 65 项随机对照试验，发现大多数干预集中在急性住院到居家照护的过渡，且常未同时纳入照护者。综述强调，需在整个照护连续体中推广以家庭为中心的干预方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Continuity of care is crucial in stroke rehabilitation. This review highlights that current interventions often focus on acute-to-home transitions and rarely include both patients and caregivers. When designing rehabilitation pathways, proactively incorporate more transition phases and family caregiver support.
items.limitation: 本综述仅纳入随机对照试验，可能遗漏了其他有价值的研究类型。
items.limitationEn: This review only included randomized controlled trials, potentially missing valuable insights from other study types.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A two-phase feasibility study of a pulmonary telerehabilitation (PR) model for COPD found high technical feasibility (≥99% clinical agreement in data transmission) and clinical feasibility (19 participants completed the program, with high satisfaction/usability). Exploratory outcomes showed increased endurance time, suggesting the model is well-accepted but requires future RCTs for efficacy assessment.
items.curatedReason: 远程肺康复（telerehabilitation PR）的平台，包括数据传输准确性、患者满意度和可用性都得到了验证，且初步临床结果显示运动耐量有所提升。如果您所在机构服务 COPD 患者，可以开始考虑将此类远程方案纳入实践，但大规模应用前仍需等待 RCT 验证其长期临床疗效。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者肺部远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者肺部远程康复（PR）模型的两阶段可行性研究发现，技术可行性高（数据传输临床一致性≥99%），临床可行性亦高（19位患者完成了该项目，患者满意度和可用性高）。探索性结果显示运动耐量有所增加，表明该模型接受度良好，但仍需未来的随机对照研究评估其临床疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: The technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation platform for COPD, including data transmission accuracy, patient satisfaction, and usability, has been validated, with preliminary clinical outcomes showing improved exercise endurance. If your institution serves COPD patients, consider integrating such telerehabilitation solutions, though large-scale adoption requires further RCT validation of long-term efficacy.
items.limitation: 这是一项前瞻性可行性研究，样本量较小（20+20），且缺乏对照组，无法评估干预的疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a prospective two-phase feasibility study with a small sample size (20+20) and no control group, so it cannot assess intervention efficacy.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Using Patient-Centered Outcomes Data to Support Reciprocal Learning and Improve Rehabilitation Care
items.summary: This commentary discusses the potential of using patient-centered outcomes (PCO) data to optimize rehabilitation care and guide health system-level learning. It highlights challenges such as siloed activities and poor communication, emphasizing the critical need for transparency among team members regarding the purpose of PCO data use.
items.curatedReason: 以患者为中心的结果（PCO）数据在康复护理中具有优化个体治疗和指导系统层面学习的潜力，但其实施面临挑战。您在临床实践中应主动提升团队内部沟通与透明度，明确 PCO 数据的使用目的，以真正实现其价值。
items.titleZh: 利用以患者为中心的结果数据支持互惠学习和改善康复护理
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章探讨了利用以患者为中心的结果（PCO）数据优化康复护理并指导卫生系统层面学习的潜力。文章强调了筒仓式活动和沟通不畅等挑战，并指出团队成员之间在 PCO 数据使用目的方面的透明度至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patient-Centered Outcomes (PCO) data have the potential to optimize individual care and guide system-level learning in rehabilitation, but implementation faces challenges. In your clinical practice, proactively enhance internal team communication and transparency, clarifying the purpose of PCO data use to truly realize its value.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A Foundational Balance Training Exercise Program for People with Blindness or Low Vision
items.summary: This commentary discusses a foundational balance training exercise program for individuals with blindness or low vision. It emphasizes that with reduced vision, there is an increased reliance on somatosensory and vestibular systems, and highlights the challenges these individuals face with balance and safe mobility.
items.curatedReason: 该述评提出了一项针对盲人或低视力人群的基础平衡训练方案。您在为这类患者设计康复计划时，可以参考其中强调的对躯体感觉和前庭系统的代偿性依赖，以弥补视觉输入的缺失，从而改善其平衡和安全移动能力。
items.titleZh: 针对盲人或低视力人群的基础平衡训练运动方案
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章讨论了针对盲人或低视力个体的一项基础平衡训练运动方案。文章强调，随着视力下降，个体对躯体感觉和前庭系统的依赖性增加，并突出了这些个体在平衡和安全移动方面面临的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary proposes a foundational balance training program for people with blindness or low vision. When designing rehabilitation plans for these patients, you can refer to its emphasis on compensatory reliance on somatosensory and vestibular systems to compensate for the lack of visual input, thereby improving their balance and safe mobility.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Clarifying 'youth: why conceptual and ethical clarity matters in sport
items.summary: This editorial highlights the conceptual and ethical issues arising from the variability in operational labels used to define 'youth' athletes across research, policy, and practice. It argues that these labels carry embedded assumptions about capacities, rights, risks, and responsibilities, calling for greater clarity.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论呼吁在运动领域对“青年”的定义进行概念和伦理上的澄清，因为当前术语的模糊性会影响对青年运动员的能力、权利、风险和责任的理解。您在涉及青少年运动员的评估和干预时，需要更细致地考量其发展阶段和特定需求。
items.titleZh: 澄清“青年”定义：为什么概念和伦理清晰度在体育运动中至关重要
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论强调了在研究、政策和实践中，用于定义“青年”运动员的术语差异所带来的概念和伦理问题。它认为这些标签包含了关于能力、权利、风险和责任的隐含假设，呼吁更清晰的定义。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial calls for conceptual and ethical clarity in defining 'youth' in sports, as vague terminology impacts understanding of young athletes' capabilities, rights, risks, and responsibilities. When assessing and intervening with adolescent athletes, you need to consider their developmental stage and specific needs more meticulously.

items.title: Championing choice: the Womens Tennis Association Fertility Protection Programme for professional women tennis players
items.summary: The Women's Tennis Association (WTA) has launched a Fertility Protection Programme for professional women tennis players. This initiative addresses unique barriers female athletes face, such as the overlap of peak performance and prime fertility, financial strain, childcare access, and lack of maternity policies, which can lead to delayed childbearing and sport-specific fertility risks.
items.curatedReason: 女子网球协会（WTA）推出的生育保护计划，旨在解决职业女运动员在巅峰竞技与生育之间的冲突。这提醒您，在与女运动员讨论职业发展和健康管理时，应将生育规划纳入考虑，并了解相关支持政策。
items.titleZh: 倡导选择：女子网球协会针对职业女网球运动员的生育保护计划
items.summaryZh: 女子网球协会（WTA）已为职业女网球运动员启动了生育保护计划。该计划旨在解决女运动员面临的独特障碍，例如巅峰表现与最佳生育期的重叠、经济压力、托儿服务、以及产假政策的缺乏，这些因素可能导致推迟生育和运动特有的生育风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Women's Tennis Association (WTA)'s Fertility Protection Programme aims to address the conflict between peak performance and fertility for professional female athletes. This reminds you to consider fertility planning when discussing career development and health management with female athletes, and to be aware of relevant support policies.

items.title: 'Written in English: has English as the lingua franca of mental health research in sport and parasport become a barrier to creating culturally and contextually situated mental health care?
items.summary: This commentary argues that English as the lingua franca in mental health research in sport and parasport, despite its facilitating communication, may hinder the creation of culturally and contextually situated mental healthcare. It calls for greater linguistic inclusivity in this field.
items.curatedReason: 尽管英语在全球运动和残疾人运动心理健康研究中占据主导地位，但这可能成为创建具有文化和语境适应性的心理健康护理的障碍。您在评估和提供心理健康支持时，应认识到语言和文化背景的重要性，并寻求多元化的资源和方法。
items.titleZh: “用英语撰写”：英语作为运动和残疾人运动心理健康研究的通用语是否已成为创建文化和语境化心理健康护理的障碍？
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章指出，尽管英语在运动和残疾人运动心理健康研究中作为通用语促进了交流，但也可能阻碍创建具有文化和语境适应性的心理健康护理。文章呼吁在该领域提高语言包容性。
items.curatedReasonEn: While English dominates global mental health research in sport and parasport, this may hinder the creation of culturally and contextually adapted mental healthcare. When assessing and providing mental health support, you should recognize the importance of language and cultural background, seeking diverse resources and approaches.

items.title: Implementation gap: a 3-year reality check in body composition monitoring in sport
items.summary: This editorial highlights an ongoing implementation gap in body composition monitoring in sport, nearly three years after the International Olympic Committee's (IOC) Consensus Statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs). It calls for greater collective commitment to translate evidence-informed recommendations into everyday practice to safeguard athlete health.
items.curatedReason: 国际奥委会关于运动中相对能量缺乏（REDs）的共识声明发布近三年后，在运动中身体成分监测的实践中仍存在实施差距。这意味着您在为运动员提供身体成分评估和管理时，仍需积极推动循证建议的落地，以更好地保护运动员健康。
items.titleZh: 实施差距：运动中身体成分监测的 3 年现实检验
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论指出，国际奥委会（IOC）关于运动中相对能量缺乏（REDs）的共识声明发布近三年后，在运动中身体成分监测的实践中仍存在实施差距。文章呼吁更广泛地共同致力于将循证建议转化为日常实践，以保护运动员健康。
items.curatedReasonEn: Nearly three years after the International Olympic Committee's (IOC) Consensus Statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs), an implementation gap persists in body composition monitoring in practice. This means that when providing body composition assessment and management for athletes, you still need to actively promote the adoption of evidence-informed recommendations to better protect athlete health.
